hook: auspicious／propitious 是晴空賀詞，ominous 是烏雲警報——氣象主播拿兩支麥克風：吉與凶。
script: auspicious＝吉利的。propitious＝有利／適合的。ominous＝兇兆的。口令：晴空寫開工，烏雲寫快跑。

members.senseAnchor: auguring favorable circumstances and good luck
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 晴空麥: auspicious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「晴空麥」出場：auspicious 一上場梗就黏住——吉利的。

members.senseAnchor: indicating a good chance of success
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 順風標: propitious walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「順風標」出場：propitious 一上場梗就黏住——有利的。

members.senseAnchor: threatening or foreshadowing evil or tragic developments; presaging ill fortune; ; ; - P.B.Shelley
members.speakLineEn: Cue the 烏雲警: ominous walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「烏雲警」出場：ominous 一上場梗就黏住——兇兆的。

related.synonyms: baleful, forbidding, menacing, minacious, minatory, sinister
